cohort: 26 women with double uterine cavities (22 bicornuate and 4 didelphic uteri) with history of recurrent pregnancy loss
finding: Laparoscopic metroplasty by developing a single uterine cavity with a suitable volume and minimal adhesion formation can be a substitute for laparotomy technique.
mod_finding: Nine term pregnancies resulted in live neonates delivered through cesarean section.
